title: Rune Temple
summary: A hanok temple in its park, south-west of the Awakened Plaza, with the rune altar: a rune found on a dungeon guardian is engraved into a weapon, an armor or a pendant (one rune per item, a new one replaces it).

blocks.text: A hanok temple in its park, south-west of the Awakened Plaza, with the rune altar: a rune found on a dungeon guardian is engraved into a weapon, an armor or a pendant (one rune per item, a new one replaces it). The item is bound for a while (10 min for a Common rune up to 5 h for a Mythic one), then the rune works while the item is worn. The binding can be skipped with shards or Robux.
